title: nephrodium parallelogrammum var. khasianum
intro: Nephrodium parallelogrammum var. khasianum, commonly known as the Khasian shield fern, is a species of fern within the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Nephrodium parallelogrammum var. khasianum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
